description: Pages whose frozen E5 image (rendered on the Apple M1) is imported from the archive instead of a fresh render, because PyMuPDF 2.1 on another processor renders different bytes. Each entry is checked by visual_index.verified_archived_pages before use: the PDF SHA-256, the frozen render manifest (against its package's SHA256SUMS), the archived PNG's SHA-256 and its pixel size. The embedding is E5's, keyed by the archived PNG's SHA-256; nothing is re-encoded. Add an entry only after verifying it as recorded in docs/PROGRESS.md (2026-11-26).
